purpose: Teach: 蠅/襪/繩/簑/襦/其/其の/舛

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが台所の蠅、つまり虫を駆除して下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your father is going to take care of the flies in the kitchen for us.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact tone. A small smile in the voice—sharing a gentle household detail. Unhurried. The natural cadence of a mother updating her son about Dad's small kindnesses.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに昔の足袋、つまり襪のお話を伺ったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad told me this story about old tabi socks.
lines.style: Soft, curious voice. A child eager to share something he learned. Eyes bright with the small pride of new knowledge. Not demanding attention, but genuinely wanting her to know.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが古い繩、つまり縄を物置から探し出して下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father found an old rope in the storage shed for us.
lines.style: Gentle appreciation in the voice. Noticing and naming her husband's quiet thoughtfulness. Slight warmth—the tone of someone content in her family's small gestures.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと展示の簑、つまり昔の蓑を見学したよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I went to see old raincoats at the museum exhibit.
lines.style: Bright, almost bouncing with the excitement of a shared outing. A child keen to report back something special he did with his father. Open and eager.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが法事の時に襦袢、つまり襦を着て下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father wore a traditional underkimono when we went to the memorial service.
lines.style: Reflective, slightly nostalgic. The voice of someone noticing and remembering a meaningful detail. Warm but measured—marking the occasion with quiet respect.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに「其の本を取って」って頼まれたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad asked me to hand him that book.
lines.style: Simple, straightforward delivery. A child reporting a small task, matter-of-fact. No drama—just a moment of being useful to Dad. Natural, everyday tone.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「其、まさに我が家の宝」って古風に仰ったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father said something old-fashioned—'That is truly the treasure of our home.'
lines.style: Wry affection in her voice. A mother gently amused by her husband's flowery speech, but charmed by it too. Slight warmth underneath the gentle teasing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに「靴が舛違い」って指摘して頂いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad pointed out that I had my shoes on the wrong feet.
lines.style: Quiet, matter-of-fact with a hint of wry self-awareness. A child reporting a small correction without defensiveness. The tone of someone used to Dad's gentle, observant nature.
